title: licaria aurea
intro: Licaria aurea, commonly known as Golden Licaria, is a tropical plant species native to Central and South America, belonging to the family Calycanthaceae. The health benefits of Golden Licaria include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to act as a natural antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating skin conditions and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of Golden Licaria include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
